EXCEPTIONAL TWO-BEDROOM APARTMENT | TWO PRIVATE BALCONIES | PRISTINE CONDITION

Morrison Estates are delighted to bring 406 Cubes 2 to the market, an impressive two-bedroom fourth-floor apartment presented in pristine condition within the highly regarded Beacon South Quarter development.

Beautifully maintained and exceptionally well presented throughout, No. 406 offers bright, contemporary accommodation with the added benefit of one of the development’s distinctive Cubes architectural features, creating an apartment with genuine character and individuality.

A standout feature of this particular property is its two separate balconies, positioned on either side of the apartment and providing outdoor access from both bedrooms and living room. Combined with extensive glazing throughout, this creates an excellent connection between the internal accommodation and outside space while allowing natural light to flow through the apartment.

The property is presented in superb walk-in condition, making it an ideal choice for an owner-occupier seeking a stylish contemporary home or a purchaser looking for a high-quality apartment in one of South Dublin’s most established residential and business locations.

THE PROPERTY

Extending to approximately 71 sq. m. / 764 sq. ft., No. 406 enjoys a cleverly designed and particularly well-balanced layout.
The entrance hallway leads into the main open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, which forms the centrepiece of the apartment. Floor-to-ceiling glazing and the distinctive Cubes design feature give this space an impressive contemporary feel while maximising natural light.

The kitchen is fully fitted with an extensive range of storage units, worktops and integrated appliances, complemented by a spacious living and dining area suitable for both everyday living and entertaining. 

There are two generous double bedrooms, thoughtfully positioned to provide a good degree of separation and privacy. Both bedrooms have the particular advantage of direct access to their own balcony areas as well as living room, effectively providing private outdoor space on either side of the apartment – a feature which sets No. 406 apart. The principal bedroom incorporates fitted wardrobes and an en-suite shower room, while the second double bedroom also benefits from fitted storage and is conveniently positioned close to the main bathroom. 

A separate utility/storage area off the hallway provides valuable additional practicality. Presented in pristine condition throughout, 406 Cubes 2 combines excellent presentation, a distinctive architectural design and two private balconies to create an outstanding contemporary apartment in the heart of Sandyford.

BEACON SOUTH QUARTER

The Cubes forms the residential element of Beacon South Quarter, a landmark contemporary development in a prime location which has become one of the most established residential addresses in the Sandyford area.

Characterised by its distinctive modern architecture, landscaped communal areas and excellent resident facilities, the development benefits from concierge reception, 24-hour on-site security, secure underground parking and lift access.

The location is exceptionally convenient. Sandyford and Stillorgan Business Districts, Beacon Hospital, Beacon Court and Central Park are all within easy reach, while many of the world’s leading international companies have significant offices within the immediate area.

For shopping, dining and leisure, residents have convenient access to Dundrum Town Centre, Carrickmines Retail Park, Beacon Shopping Centre and the villages of Sandyford, Stillorgan, Stepaside and Foxrock.

Excellent transport connections include the nearby LUAS and M50, making the location particularly convenient for access to Dublin City Centre and the wider Dublin region.

Features Include: 

Bright, well-proportioned accommodation c. 71.27 Sq. M ( 767 Sq. Ft)

Owner Occupied and set out in turn key condition 

Modern Cubes Feature with views to Dublin mountains

Two Private balconies each bedroom and access from living room

Fully fitted kitchen, with feature worktops and integrated appliances, light fittings and built-in kitchen appliances namely oven, hob, extractor fan, dishwasher, oven/microwave and fridge/freezer included in the sale 

Separate utility closet area in the hallway

Quality sanitary ware throughout. 

Concierge Reception onsite

24/7, 365 day security on-site

Double glazed windows throughout

Security Intercom

Lutron Mood Lighting

Lift to all floors 

Designated underground car parking space approached by electronic security gates 

Meticulously maintained landscaped grounds within the development 

Convenient location close to the M50, Carrickmines Retail Park, Dundrum, Sandyford and a short walk to LUAS

Owner occupied and no chain for vendor so property is available to move into

No Rent Caps as property is owner occupied 

ACCOMMODATION

Reception Hallway 2m x 2m - A welcoming entrance hallway with quality flooring, recessed lighting, hot press and access to the principal accommodation.
Open-Plan Living / Dining / Kitchen 5.4m x 4.65m overall plus 2.4m x 2m cube feature - Bright and stylish central living space incorporating the distinctive Cubes architectural feature, extensive glazing, recessed lighting and TV point. The layout provides excellent space for separate living and dining areas while retaining an attractive open-plan feel.
Kitchen - Contemporary fitted kitchen incorporating a comprehensive range of built-in presses and storage units, worktops, oven, ceramic hob, microwave, stainless-steel extractor, sink unit, fridge/freezer, dishwasher and additional storage.
Bedroom One 3.2m x 2.9m overall - Generously proportioned principal double bedroom with built-in wardrobes and the excellent additional benefit of direct access to a private balcony.
En-Suite Shower Room
Fully tiled en-suite incorporating step-in shower, WC with concealed cistern, vanity wash-hand basin, fitted mirror/storage and tiled walls and floor.
Bedroom Two 3.9m x 3.1m - Spacious second double bedroom with built-in wardrobes and direct access to the second balcony, providing an additional private outdoor area.
Main Bathroom  2.7m x 1.9m - Well-appointed contemporary bathroom incorporating bath with shower over, WC with concealed cistern, vanity wash-hand basin, fitted mirror and storage, recessed lighting and fully tiled walls and floor.

TWO BALCONIES

One of the particular attractions of No. 406 is the presence of two separate balcony areas positioned on either side of the apartment.
With access serving both bedrooms, these outdoor spaces add another dimension to the accommodation and are a particularly appealing feature for an apartment of this size.

DEVELOPMENT & PARKING
The property benefits from a designated underground car parking space, accessed through electronically controlled security gates.
Residents of The Cubes also enjoy concierge reception, 24-hour on-site security, lift access to all floors and professionally maintained landscaped communal areas.
